plain: Rule or control over a place or people

webster.text: Sovereign or supreme authority; the power of governing and controlling.

more.text: Power to direct, control, use and dispose of at pleasure; right of possession and use without being accountable; as the private dominion of individuals.

example.quote: Unhappily for the other three, Europe, by her arms and by her negotiations, by force and by fraud, has, in different degrees, extended her dominion over them all.
